subject: possible bug in hline when combined with  coord_flip()

messages.author: 46f0fec04a5c6039
messages.subject: possible bug in hline when combined with  coord_flip()
parts:
Simple test case:

Straight plot:
ggplot(data.frame(a=1:10, b=1:5), aes(x=a, y=b)) + geom_point() +
geom_hline(aes(yintercept=3))

flipped plot:

ggplot(data.frame(a=1:10, b=1:5), aes(x=a, y=b)) + geom_point() +
geom_hline(aes(yintercept=3)) + coord_flip()

in the flipped plot the line does not extend to the whole figure as in
the un-flipped plot.
Alex
